description: M4 step 2, the AI frame (battle-sim.md §14): your two squads hold a line (side 0, no orders: Hold); the enemy AI plays the raiders (side 1). Outnumbering you, they attack: each squad goes for the nearest of yours, at most two on one while the other stands free, and the second squad on a target goes round to its open flank before it strikes. Ulfr (proud, elite) leads the Raider line and gives his battle cry once he is in contact with at least 4 of your men. Watch the replay for the flank march, the cry and, if a raider squad breaks, its regrouping.
